title: Backend Python Engineer
description: Build and operate Python/FastAPI services for a SaaS product. 2-6 years of experience, strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, testing and cloud deployment.

competencies.name: Python Programming
questions: Tell me about a Python codebase you are proud of. What made it maintainable?

rubric.1: Only basic scripts; no evidence of structure.
rubric.3: Builds working services/modules in Python with some structure.
rubric.5: Designs well-structured, tested, idiomatic Python systems and explains trade-offs.

competencies.name: REST API Design
questions: Walk me through how you designed an API that other teams relied on.

rubric.3: Has built CRUD APIs with basic validation.
rubric.5: Designs versioned APIs with contracts, error handling, pagination and backward compatibility.

competencies.name: Databases and SQL
competencies.description: Models data, writes efficient queries, understands indexing and transactions.
questions: Describe a time you had to fix a slow database query or redesign a schema.

rubric.3: Designs schemas and writes joins/indexes for real workloads.
rubric.5: Diagnoses performance with query plans, designs for scale and consistency, explains trade-offs.

competencies.name: System Design
competencies.description: Designs scalable, reliable systems and reasons about trade-offs.
questions: Tell me about a system you designed or significantly re-architected. What trade-offs did you make?

rubric.3: Contributes to designs of services with some scale considerations.
rubric.5: Leads designs, quantifies load, explains failure modes and trade-offs.

competencies.name: Testing and Quality
competencies.description: Writes automated tests and builds quality into the process.
questions: How do you decide what to test, and can you give an example where tests caught a serious bug?

rubric.3: Writes unit tests for own code.
rubric.5: Builds layered test strategy, automates in CI, uses tests to enable safe refactoring.

competencies.name: Cloud and DevOps
competencies.description: Deploys and operates services on cloud infrastructure.
questions: Describe how your last service went from a pull request to production.

rubric.3: Containerises and deploys with a pipeline.
rubric.5: Owns infra-as-code, observability and safe rollouts.

competencies.name: Problem Solving
competencies.description: Breaks down ambiguous problems and debugs systematically.
questions: Tell me about the hardest bug or performance problem you solved. How did you approach it?

rubric.3: Debugs methodically and fixes root causes in familiar areas.
rubric.5: Forms hypotheses, measures, finds root causes in unfamiliar systems and prevents recurrence.

competencies.name: Communication and Collaboration
competencies.description: Explains technical ideas clearly and works well with others.
questions: Tell me about a time you had to explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder.

rubric.5: Adapts to audiences, documents decisions, builds alignment across teams.

competencies.name: Leadership and Mentoring
competencies.description: Mentors others and drives technical direction.
questions: Tell me about a time you helped another engineer grow or led a piece of work.

rubric.3: Has mentored or led small pieces of work.
rubric.5: Grows others, sets direction, takes accountability for team outcomes.

competencies.name: Security Awareness
questions: How do you approach security when building a new feature that handles user data?

rubric.5: Threat-models features, applies defence in depth, handles secrets and audits dependencies.
